# Owlvix

> Owlvix designs, builds and launches web apps, mobile apps and AI tools for growing businesses — from the first sketch to the server it runs on. 7+ years, 200+ projects delivered, clients worldwide. Free quote within 24 hours, and clients own 100% of the code.

## About

- [About Owlvix](https://owlvix.com/about): founded by Jawad Ahmad (founder and lead developer), with a small team of developers and designers. Based in Pakistan, working with clients in the USA, UK and 70+ countries; building software since 2018. Jawad's Fiverr profile is Jawad Ahmad (@anjtec), with 200+ completed orders; the reviews on owlvix.com come from it.

## Services

Full details of every service, who it suits and what is included: https://owlvix.com/services

- [Custom web apps](https://owlvix.com/web-app-development): dashboards, portals, SaaS products and booking systems built with Laravel, React and Vue.
- [Mobile apps](https://owlvix.com/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android apps that share one codebase (React Native) and connect to existing systems.
- [AI chatbots](https://owlvix.com/ai-chatbot-development): website and customer support bots trained on a business's own documents, FAQs and products.
- [AI agents and automation](https://owlvix.com/ai-agent-development): repetitive tasks and workflows handed to AI that follows the business's rules and reports back.
- [API integrations](https://owlvix.com/api-integration-services): OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, payments, CRMs and ERPs connected to the tools a business already uses.
- [Shopify store development](https://owlvix.com/shopify-development): new stores, theme customization, apps, migrations and speed fixes.
- [WordPress website development](https://owlvix.com/wordpress-development): business websites, WooCommerce stores, redesigns, fixes and speed.
- [ERP and CRM development](https://owlvix.com/erp-crm-development): custom systems for customers, sales, inventory, orders, invoices and reports.
- [Landing page design](https://owlvix.com/landing-page-design): fast, mobile-first pages for ads, launches and lead generation.
- [UI/UX design](https://owlvix.com/ui-ux-design): user flows, wireframes, screen design and clickable prototypes for web and mobile apps.
- [MVP development](https://owlvix.com/mvp-development): focused first versions of startup products, built to grow.
- [SEO services](https://owlvix.com/seo-services): technical SEO audits and fixes, page speed, structured data and on-page optimization.

## How it works

- [Process](https://owlvix.com/#process): 1) share your idea and get a plan with a clear quote; 2) design and build with weekly progress on a live preview; 3) tested launch, full source code handover, and ongoing support.
- [Pricing](https://owlvix.com/#pricing): milestone projects that start free (project plan and key screen designs at no cost, no upfront payment), then as many milestones as agreed, each paid only after the client approves it, with a fixed total price agreed up front and source code handed over on final payment.
- [FAQ](https://owlvix.com/#faq): most websites take 1–3 weeks and most web apps 3–8 weeks; clients own all code, designs and accounts once paid; Owlvix takes over and extends existing apps; works with OpenAI, Anthropic Claude and Google Gemini; can set up hosting, domains, email and SSL.

## Free tools

All tools: https://owlvix.com/free-tools

- [App & website cost calculator](https://owlvix.com/project-cost-calculator): instant price range and timeline for a website, store, web app, mobile app, AI chatbot/agent or ERP, from project type, size, design level and features.
- [Website security & SSL checker](https://owlvix.com/security-checker): passive check of HTTPS, SSL certificate (trust, expiry, TLS), security headers, cookie flags and version leaks, with fixes.
- [Tech stack detector](https://owlvix.com/tech-stack-detector): shows what a website is built with (CMS, e-commerce platform, frameworks, hosting/CDN, analytics, payments).
- [Meta tag & social preview](https://owlvix.com/meta-tag-preview): previews a page on Google, WhatsApp, Facebook/LinkedIn and X and generates corrected meta tags.
- [Broken link checker](https://owlvix.com/broken-link-checker): scans the homepage and up to 7 linked pages, checks up to 150 links and images, and lists broken links, redirects and where each appears.
- [Email & DNS checker](https://owlvix.com/email-dns-checker): checks a domain's MX, SPF (including the 10-lookup limit), DKIM, DMARC and name servers, explains why email lands in spam and suggests the exact records.
- [Ads budget & ROI calculator](https://owlvix.com/ads-roi-calculator): clicks, leads, customers, cost per lead, ROAS, profit and break-even cost per click for Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads.
- [Schema markup generator](https://owlvix.com/schema-markup-generator): JSON-LD for local businesses, organizations, products, articles, FAQ pages and breadcrumbs.
- [Redirect & HTTP header checker](https://owlvix.com/redirect-checker): follows a URL hop by hop (status codes, timing, final headers) and checks that http/https and www/non-www resolve to one address.
- [Robots.txt & AI crawler checker](https://owlvix.com/robots-txt-checker): tests robots.txt rules (Google matching), sitemap, noindex, and whether Googlebot, Bingbot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot and AI training bots are allowed.
- [Domain age & expiry checker](https://owlvix.com/domain-age-checker): registrar, creation and expiry dates, transfer lock, DNSSEC and name servers via RDAP (WHOIS fallback).
- [Landing page builder](https://owlvix.com/landing-page-builder): build a landing page from 4 designs and 6 industry examples (dental, restaurant, consultant, online course, real estate, home services) and download one self-contained HTML file; runs in the browser.
- [Funnel builder](https://owlvix.com/funnel-builder): free sales funnel builder — opt-in, sales, upsell and thank-you steps; lead collection with CSV export and Mailchimp/Brevo/webhook delivery; payments via the owner's own Stripe/PayPal link; per-step stats and A/B tests.
- [Website builder](https://owlvix.com/website-builder): free multi-page website builder — ready business sites (consultant, clinic, restaurant, home services, real estate) with Home, About, Services, Contact and Menu pages; download or publish free.
- [Portfolio builder](https://owlvix.com/portfolio-builder): free portfolio website builder for photographers, designers, developers and artists — work gallery, about, packages, reviews and a working contact form.
- [Link in bio builder](https://owlvix.com/link-in-bio-builder): free link in bio page (Linktree alternative) for Instagram, TikTok and YouTube — photo, bio, link buttons (web, WhatsApp, email) and social icons.
- [Coming soon page builder](https://owlvix.com/coming-soon-page-builder): free coming soon, under maintenance and opening soon pages with a countdown, sign-up form and social links.
- [Email signature generator](https://owlvix.com/email-signature-generator): free email signature generator — 6 designs, photo, logo, social icons and a button; copy and paste into Gmail, Outlook or Apple Mail. Runs in the browser.
- [Image compressor](https://owlvix.com/image-compressor): compresses, resizes and converts images to WebP/JPEG in the browser; nothing is uploaded.

- [Website speed test](https://owlvix.com/website-speed-test): free speed score, Core Web Vitals and top fixes for any URL, powered by Google PageSpeed Insights; downloadable PDF report.

- [SEO checker](https://owlvix.com/seo-checker): free on-page and technical SEO audit of any URL (titles, meta, headings, content, schema, robots.txt, sitemap, speed, social tags) with a tip for every issue; tips can be emailed.
- [Free SEO audit](https://owlvix.com/seo-audit): request a full whole-site SEO audit (technical, content, search intent, speed, AI search readiness) delivered as a PDF within 2 business days.
